evaluation.matching: Identical presampled four-component initial states and per-step action uniforms for all frozen snapshots.

manifest.scope: Only actor.update is wrapped for copying weights after every16 original minibatch updates; no arithmetic/RNG changes. All frozen evaluations are run after original learn(data) completes. Surrogate and exact Bernoulli KL are measured on that unchanged update rollout batch.
